    LargeIndecomposable.RayQuiver.MulBasis.not_zigzag_arms_src

    Zigzags with two arms, one at a source: BO13a figure 9.5 #

    The diagram: an arm x₀ → M₀ → E₀ with s₀ : M₀ → z p; the zigzag σ (p+j) (j ≤ L), ρ (p+j+1) (j < L) from z p to the source x (p+L+1); r : x (p+L+1) → M and an arm X'' → M → E. It is an orientation of D̃₂ₗ₊₇ (RayCat.ZAB).
